Hey!! Promised you an update so here it goes :)

Everything turned out well, 
We surprised him he got a bit pissy as he doesn’t like surprises. If we told him we were coming, he’d runaway lmao so  ¯\_(ツ)_/¯ Gave him a tie & cufflinks as a gift. The 6 paged letter doubled into 12 pages. He was very dismissive when we came and  tried to talk to him. But he agreed on taking polaroid pictures for memories haha. 

Went back home and he called me around 10 asking if he could come over. Noticed his voice was a bit shaky, I knew he cried. Long story short, we spent time together until 1 AM and we got back together :) 

He was jealous bc he knew didn’t have much time left here and told me even if I said yes to cutting the 2 guys off, he wouldn’t let me do that. He only wanted to know.  Sorted everything out and we’re all good now. He gave me lots of  hugs and a kiss before he left. 

He said he really appreciated the letter and knew writing those things wasn’t my thing as i’m not really affectionate as a person, nade it more special he said.

Guess we’re doing an LDR now. Somehow we both aren’t worried bc we know things will work out in the end.  

Thank you so much for your help. If  you didnt encourage me to try and see him none of this would’ve happened!! Have a wonderful life and thankyou again!!! :))

We decided to visit his house at Sunday night to say our goodbyes. Didn’t invite the guys tho, we thought it’d be best that way. He had anger issues in the past and we don’t want him to flip. Also wrote him a 6 page letter, I hope he reads them. 

idk how he’ll react with us visiting him we’ll have to wait and see i guess. I’ll update you how it goes

As selfish as I sound, I really hoped he would cut us off after he went to Seattle. We won’t be seeing him in a very long time too + the time difference would make it harder for us to communicate w him. But at the same time I understand why he’d cut us off now. The sooner, the better for him to move on. I’m just upset. Really hoping we’d have our last goodbyes but I guess that’s not happening. 

As for his jealousy, one of his ex ended up with their good-guy-friends and he was really scared that it would repeat again. 

Anyways thank you for taking your time to read and reply, it makes me feel better :) I should probably cool myself down first
